parsed.rationale_overall: System A directly addresses the user's query for a year-by-year glide path with an explicit 11-year allocation schedule and concrete Year-1 dollar amounts, whereas System B's glide path is inconsistent (ends at 60/40 after de-risking toward 48/52) and less responsive to the query. System B has a stronger diversification recommendation (explicit healthcare overweight fix) and adds tax-location value, but System A is more personalized, better grounded, and more actionable overall.
